name: Amphitheater
summary: Outdoor performance venue priced per seat of total capacity (fixed + lawn). Cost per seat varies ~10x with the share of fixed/covered seating, the stage house/shell and back-of-house, and urban vs. greenfield sites: lawn-heavy pavilions ≈ $1,000/seat (Walmart AMP 2014), modern mid-size municipal venues ≈ $5,000/seat (Orion 2022), premium shells ≈ $8,000–10,000/seat (Daily's Place, Rady Shell). Figures are total project costs from Wikipedia infoboxes/citations; hard cost is derived with an assumed hard-cost share.

typicalSize.method: Examples: 5,990 (e7), 6,800 (e6), 8,000 (e1), 11,000 (e3). Municipal community amphitheaters are often 1,500–3,000. Mid 5,000.

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Enclosed/roofed building SF (stage house, BOH, dressing, concessions, restrooms) per capacity seat; derived from typical programs (e.g., 15,000–30,000 SF of buildings for 5,000–8,000 seats). Excludes lawn.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Seats per acre of venue site excluding remote parking: lawn ~10 SF/person, fixed seats ~7 SF, plus stage, concourses and support. Derived.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Assembly zoning commonly 1 space per 3–4 seats; urban venues rely on shared/structured parking. Derived.

perPrimaryUnit.method: 2022 dollars, hard cost per capacity seat. Total project cost per seat: e3 $1,045 (2014), e1 $5,000 (2022), e2 $8,145 (2016, includes practice field), e4 $10,000 (2021, premium), e5 $655 (1991, not used for mid). Applying ~0.75–0.80 hard-cost share: e1 ≈ $3,900, e4 ≈ $7,800, e3 ≈ $850 (≈ $1,100 in 2022). Mid $3,500 sits slightly below the Orion-derived figure to represent a typical municipal venue with a moderate fixed-seat share (~30–40% fixed, cf. e6/e7). Low ≈ lawn-dominant pavilion (e3); high ≈ premium shell (e4).

perSF.method: perPrimaryUnit / sfPerPrimaryUnit — not meaningful as a building $/SF because seating bowl, lawn and site are included; shown only for completeness (800/2, 3500/4, 8000/8).

scope.notes: Stage/shell, BOH, concessions/restrooms, seating bowl and lawn, site utilities, lighting and on-site parking. Excludes production sound/lighting packages (lineItem), land, soft costs, off-sites.

qualityTiers.method: economy ≈ low/mid (800/3500 ≈ 0.23, rounded up); luxury = high/mid (8000/3500 ≈ 2.3); premium ≈ Orion-type (e1-derived $3,900–5,000)/mid ≈ 1.4–1.6.

systemSplit.method: Derived: concrete seating bowl and stage (03 ≈ 14%), long-span stage roof/shell steel (05 ≈ 12%), fixed seating (12), rigging/stage equipment (11), heavy site work for raked lawn (31/32 ≈ 12%), power for production (26). Not sourced.

cost.method: Derived allowance per installed fixed seat; qty 0.35 per capacity seat from fixed-seat shares of ~30–34% (e6, e7).

lineItems.name: Stage house / acoustic shell / canopy roof

cost.method: Derived allowance; premium symphony shells (e4) at the top.

lineItems.name: Production sound, lighting and video package

cost.method: Derived allowance; often operator-provided or rented.
Park restroom contracts $265k–$608k each (amenities block) scaled for event peak loads, plus concessions.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Movable seating, bar/concession fixtures, signage, operations equipment. Derived.

pctOfHard.method: Theatre/acoustic consultants, structural for long-span shells, civil, sound studies, permits; public projects carry owner's rep/CM fees. Derived.

softCosts.notes: Noise studies and neighborhood mitigation are common soft items.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Total project cost per seat range of e1–e4 (≈ $1,045–10,000) with margin.

evidence.quote: The amphitheater, which cost $40 million to build, is owned by the city of Huntsville. ... Capacity 8000
evidence.scopeNotes: $40M / 8,000 capacity ≈ $5,000 per seat; opened 2022; likely total project cost.

evidence.quote: seats 5,500 spectators ... Cost $44.8 million ... shares space with a "flex field" indoor practice facility for the Jacksonville Jaguars
evidence.scopeNotes: Covered amphitheater under one roof with an indoor NFL practice field (hangar doors between), so cost includes non-amphitheater space; $44.8M / 5,500 ≈ $8,145 per seat. High outlier.

evidence.quote: Capacity 11,000 Construction Groundbreaking October 2013 Opened June 7, 2014 ... Cost $ 11.5 million
evidence.scopeNotes: Lawn-heavy outdoor pavilion; $11.5M / 11,000 ≈ $1,045 per capacity seat. Expanded 2016 (not included).

source.title: The Rady Shell at Jacobs Park

evidence.quote: A sloping lawn covered with artificial turf provides variable amounts of seating for 2,000 to 8,500 guests. ... "San Diego Symphony Starts New Era with Friday Opening of $85 Million Rady Shell at Jacobs Park Concert Venue"
evidence.scopeNotes: Premium symphony shell incl. park improvements (lighting, public restrooms); $85M / 8,500 ≈ $10,000 per seat. Upper bound.

evidence.quote: It was built by the City of Raleigh, with private sector participation, at a cost of $13.5 million and opened on July 4, 1991 ... Capacity 20,601
evidence.scopeNotes: Large shed-and-lawn amphitheater; 1991 dollars (too old for defaults, kept for spread). ≈ $655 per seat.

evidence.quote: The amphitheater seats 2,300 in fixed seating, and 4,500 on the lawn, with a total capacity of 6,800.
Seating capacity is 5,990: 1,800 fixed seats; 2,700 movable seats; and lawn space for 1,000.
